package fixture

import "os"

// fakeWorkerDescription stands in for the worker description pulled off a
// remote; the checker reads the file, never the disk the path names.
const fakeWorkerDescription = `{"name":"w","key_file":` + `C:\Users\RUNN\keys\key` + `}`

func writesWorker(dir string) {
	_ = os.WriteFile(dir, []byte(fakeWorkerDescription), 0o644)
}
